news.title: As scores dip, Michigan law takes effect dropping essay from standardized test
news.summary_en: Michigan high school juniors will no longer be required to complete the SAT essay portion of the Michigan Merit Exam beginning this school year legislation that took effect July 1.
news.author: Janelle D. James
